paite: Toupa PATHIAN thu ka kiang ah ahong tung nawn a,
heading: Tura Kumpipa Kalh A Genkholhna
english: Yahweh’s word came again to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Tura heutupa kiang ah gen inla, Toupa PATHIAN in, hichi in achi: Na lungsim akisathei a, Pathian ka hi a, tuipi lai a Pathian tutmun ah ka tu, na chi a; himahleh mihing lel na hi a, pathian na hi kei a, pathian lungsim bang in kingaihtuah mah lechin;
english: “Son of man, tell the prince of Tyre, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because your heart is lifted up, and you have said, ‘I am a god, I sit in the seat of God, in the middle of the seas;’ yet you are man, and no god, though you set your heart as the heart of a god—

paite: Daniel sang in na pilzaw a, na lak ah thuguk a-om thei kei a;
english: behold, you are wiser than Daniel. There is no secret that is hidden from you.

paite: na pilna leh na lemtheihna in na na kihihhau a; na goubawm ah dangka leh dangka-eng na khum hi.
english: By your wisdom and by your understanding you have gotten yourself riches, and have gotten gold and silver into your treasuries.

paite: Na pilna thupi mahmah leh na sumsaina in sum na hihpung a; na hauhsak ziak in na lungsim ana kisatheita hi."
english: By your great wisdom and by your trading you have increased your riches, and your heart is lifted up because of your riches—”

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Pathian lungsim bang pu a na kingaihtuah ziak in,
english: “‘therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Because you have set your heart as the heart of God,

paite: ngai in, na kiang ah gamdangmi, nam lauhuaitak ka hon pilut sin ahi; huan, na pilna gah kilawm tung ah anamsau uh alek ding ua, na thupina ahihse ding uh.
english: therefore, behold, I will bring strangers on you, the terrible of the nations. They will draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom. They will defile your brightness.

paite: Khuk thuk ah ahon sawllut ding ua, tuipi lai a athahte uh sih in na si ding.
english: They will bring you down to the pit. You will die the death of those who are slain in the heart of the seas.

paite: Nang hon thatmi ma ah, Pathian ka hi, na chi lailai dia hia? Nang hon liamsakmi khut ah pathian na hi kei a, mihing lel na hi zaw.
english: Will you yet say before him who kills you, ‘I am God’? But you are man, and not God, in the hand of him who wounds you.

paite: Pau tuam mite khut ah, zeksum louh sih in na si ding; ka pauta ngal a," chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: You will die the death of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers; for I have spoken it,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

paite: Huai lou leng ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
heading: Tura Kumpipa Pukna
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Tura kumpipa suunna la phuak inla, akiang ah, Hichi in Toupa PATHIAN in achi: Hoih buchingtak, pilna a dim, kilawmna chiteng;
english: “Son of man, take up a lamentation over the king of Tyre, and tell him, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “You were the seal of full measure, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.

paite: Pathian huan, Eden ah na teng a; suangmantam chiteng in na kituam a, sardi, topaz leh diamond, beril, onik, jasper, sapphir, emerald, karbankul, aphumkipna leh agelh kilawmna dangka-eng a bawlte, nang siam ni a kisiamte.
english: You were in Eden, the garden of God. Every precious stone adorned you: ruby, topaz, emerald, chrysolite, onyx, jasper, sapphire, turquoise, and beryl. Gold work of tambourines and of pipes was in you. They were prepared in the day that you were created.

paite: Nang chingmi cherub sathau nilh na hi; Pathian tang siangthou ah ka hon omsak a, meisuangte lak ah na vak hi.
english: You were the anointed cherub who covers. Then I set you up on the holy mountain of God. You have walked up and down in the middle of the stones of fire.

paite: Na hoih buching; siam a na om ni a kipan, nang a diktatlouhna a-om mateng in.
english: You were perfect in your ways from the day that you were created, until unrighteousness was found in you.

paite: Na sumsinna apun hulhul ziak in hiamgamna in na dim a, khelhna ah na pukta hi. Pathian tang a kipan in bangmah lou in ka hon paita a; chingmi cherub in meisuangte lak a kipan ahon delhkhia hi.
english: By the abundance of your commerce, your insides were filled with violence, and you have sinned. Therefore I have cast you as profane out of God’s mountain. I have destroyed you, covering cherub, from the middle of the stones of fire.

paite: Na kilawmna ziak a hong kisathei in, na thupina a na pilna hihsia in, lei ah ka hon pai a, etnop ding in kumpipate ma ah mual ah ka hon phou hi.
english: Your heart was lifted up because of your beauty. You have corrupted your wisdom by reason of your splendor. I have cast you to the ground. I have laid you before kings, that they may see you.

paite: Na sumsin diktatlouhnate ah, na siatna ziak in, na mun siangthoute na hihbuah a, huaiziak in mei ka khah a; na sung a kipan ahong kangbei a, ahon musekte tengteng muh in lei ah leivui ka hon suaksakta.
english: By the multitude of your iniquities, in the unrighteousness of your commerce, you have profaned your sanctuaries. Therefore I have brought out a fire from the middle of you. It has devoured you. I have turned you to ashes on the earth in the sight of all those who see you.

paite: Mite lak a ahon thei peuhmah lamdangsak, launa na hong suakta; na om ngei nawn kei ding," chi in.
english: All those who know you among the peoples will be astonished at you. You have become a terror, and you will exist no more.”’”

paite: Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a:
heading: Sidon Dem A Genlawkna
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Sidon masuan inla, atungthu gen in.
english: “Son of man, set your face toward Sidon, and prophesy against it,

paite: Hichi in Toupa PATHIAN in achi: Ka hon nang ahi, aw Sidon, ka hihlang ding, ka thupina; nang ah TOUPA ka hihdan athei ding ua, amah ah vai ka hawm hun chiang in, ka sianthouna ka ensak mahmah ding.
english: and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against you, Sidon. I will be glorified among you. Then they will know that I am Yahweh, when I have executed judgments in her, and am sanctified in her.

paite: Akongzing ah sisan leh hipi ka tungsak ding, asung ah miliam apuk ding; mun kil chih a kipan namsau in. Huan TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh.
english: For I will send pestilence into her, and blood into her streets. The wounded will fall within her, with the sword on her on every side. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.

paite: "Huchi in Israel inkote sun ding loulingnei a-om kei ding a, akim a amau musit mite lak ah hihna ding ling a-omta kei ding; kei Toupa PATHIAN ka hi chih athei ding uh."
heading: Israel Vualzawl In A-om Ding
english: “‘“There will no longer be a pricking brier to the house of Israel, nor a hurting thorn of any that are around them that scorned them. Then they will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.”

paite: Hichi in Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi: "Israel inkote adalhna gam mite lak a kipan ka pikhawm nawn hun chiang in Jakob kiang a ka piak, agam mahmah uah atengta ding uh,
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “When I have gathered the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they are scattered, and am shown as holy among them in the sight of the nations, then they will dwell in their own land which I gave to my servant Jacob.

paite: Huchi in bittak in a-omta ding ua; ahi, innte alam ding ua; grephuante abawl ding uh. Bittak in a-om ding ua; akim ua musit mite tengteng tung a vai ka hawm chiang in kei TOUPA a Pathian uh ka hi chih athei ding uh," chi in.
english: They will dwell in it securely. Yes, they will build houses, plant vineyards, and will dwell securely when I have executed judgments on all those around them who have treated them with contempt. Then they will know that I am Yahweh their God.”’”
